prompt.alinti: If there is one GitHub repo that you should be running inside of **Clod** or chat, it should be this one.
It's called **Everything Clod Code** by Afan Mustafa.
At the Anthropic Hackathon, he built out 75 developers and took home a prize of $15,000.
It's sitting with 230,000 stars on GitHub and over 67 specialized agents, 278 skills, 94 slash commands, 29 rules, and 14 MCPs, all in one single repo.
And even though it says **Clod Code**, it runs across every major platform as one plugin install.
Drop **Toolkit** in the comments and I will send you the repo link along with a free guide on how to take advantage of it to the highest extent.
